text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is not a review article focused on LULC future prediction; it is an application-oriented research paper presenting six case studies from Germany and Australia. While it discusses scenarios and land use planning, it fails multiple core inclusion criteria: (1) it operates at regional/local scales (e.g., Hohenlohe, Southwest Germany), not national scale; (2) LULC prediction is not the primary focus—rather, it demonstrates integrative frameworks bridging natural and human sciences; (3) although scenarios are used, they are not quantitatively compared across ≥2 future projections with accuracy metrics; (4) outputs include synthetic soil maps and habitat potentials, but not explicit national-scale mapped LULC projections. Additionally, some case studies have ecological/species-focused objectives (e.g., heathland prediction), which aligns with exclusion criteria when unrelated to broad LULC change analysis.)
